in_sanskrit.name: prabhala
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Prabal is derived from the Sanskrit word 'prabhala', which means 'one who is powerful, strong, mighty, or excellent'. In Hindu mythology, Prabal is a name of Lord Shiva and represents his destructive and protective powers.

in_marathi.name: Prabal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prabal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Prabal means 'powerful' or 'strong'. This name is often given to babies who are believed to have great potential and the ability to overcome challenges.
